2024
Bench: Dipankar Datta, Prashant Kumar Mishra
 1
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal No. 4531 Of 2024
 [arising out of Slp (Crl.) No. 14398 of 2024]
 Deepak Singare Appellant
 Versus
 The State Of Chhattisgarh Responden
 Order

1. Leave granted.
2.
The High Court by the impugned judgment and order dated 3 rd May, 2024 has rejected the appellants prayer for bail.

3. The appellant is accused of commission of offence under Sections 409, 120B, 420 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 arising out of FIR/Crime No. 596 of 2015 dated 19 th August, 2015 registered with Police Station Supela, District Durg, Chhattisgarh .

4. It is not in dispute that the trial is in progress and out of the 117 witnesses listed in the charge-sheet, 53 have been examined.
5.
The appellant has been behind bars since 29th September, 2015.

6. time and bearing in mind that the appellant has already spent more than 9(nine) years as an under trial prisoner, we are of the considered opinion that the appellant ought to be released on bail,
pending trial.
7. The impugned order stands set aside.
The appellant shall be released on bail subject to such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the trial court.
